description:
Teen Ali is given as the name of an Assam tea garden, but no source documents it, and its district and owner are unknown.

Any tea sold under this name would presumably follow the usual Assam black tea process: withered, rolled or cut, fully oxidised and fired. That is what is typical of the region, not a report on this garden.

Expect the region's malt and briskness, and start with about three and a half minutes in water just off the boil.

If you see it for sale, ask the seller for the district, flush and grade, which will tell you more than the name does.
history: Little is documented about this garden: no founding date, owner or location has been established.
